nests.label: Mahāpajāpatī Gotamī
nests.blurb: First Buddhist bhikkhunī — aunt and foster mother of the Buddha.

nests.label: Yeshe Tsogyal
nests.blurb: Tibetan Buddhist “Mother of Wisdom” — consort and disciple of Padmasambhava.

nests.label: Dipa Ma
nests.blurb: Modern Theravāda meditation master — householder path to deep practice.

nests.label: St. Clare of Assisi
nests.blurb: Founder of the Poor Clares — radical poverty with Francis.

nests.label: Hildegard of Bingen
nests.blurb: Mystic, composer, abbess — visions, music, and natural philosophy.

nests.label: St. Thérèse of Lisieux
nests.blurb: The “Little Way” — Carmelite simplicity and trust.

nests.label: St. Teresa of Calcutta
nests.blurb: Mother Teresa — Missionaries of Charity; service to the poorest.

fact.headline: Spotlight, not authority.
fact.body: amachat hosts neighbor notes on great women of religious history — Buddhist amas/nuns and Catholic (and other) nuns. It does not ordain, absolve, or speak for any tradition. Prefer primary texts and reputable biographies over rumor.
